verdict: Leads are arriving at a solid cost — but none are entering your pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 114 leads from Meta at a cost of $15.69 per lead, and the final days of the period showed a sharp recovery in lead volume — 25 leads in the last three days versus 10 in the three days prior. The real concern is downstream: those leads are not making it into your pipeline, and zero opportunities have been created in the CRM this period, which is an intake issue, not an ads issue. To address this, automated lead logging and case tracking are being activated this week, and a retargeting audience has already been uploaded to re-engage contacts who didn't convert. Your local search profile also showed a significant drop in engagement week-over-week, and a posting cadence going live today is the first step to stabilizing that visibility. Next period, expect clearer pipeline data as the CRM automation comes online and retargeting begins working the existing lead pool.
